property_summary: For every input, C.transfer always forwards a call to the callee using the selector for transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (so the callee's recorded decoded arguments match (from, to, v) and the call succeeds), whereas the mutant uses the selector for transfer(address,address,uint256) which yields a different selector/decoded args and therefore can cause a different external call behavior (different decoded arguments or failed dispatch) — we assert that the recording callee observed exactly the transferFrom selector and the corresponding decoded arguments for the single recipient case; the mutant can violate this for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the selector computation to use transfer(address,address,uint256) so the external call encodes a different function selector and may return differently.
